name: movie
description:
Returns a movie by its database identifier. Use this when you have an exact
ID, typically from a prior `search` or `movies` call. Returns null if no
movie exists with that ID, so check for null before assuming success.
operation: query Tool_movie($id: ID!) { movie(id: $id) { id title releaseYear genre rating runtime plot posterUrl tmdbId reviewCount } }

name: movies
description:
Returns a page of movies, optionally filtered. Pass a `MovieFilter` input to
constrain by release year window, genre, or minimum rating. Use `page` and
`size` for pagination; page numbering starts at 0. If `filter` is null, the
whole catalog is paged in the default sort order; pass `sort` to control
ordering. For free-text search across titles and names, use `search` instead.
operation: query Tool_movies($filter: MovieFilter, $page: Int, $size: Int, $sort: MovieSort) { movies(filter: $filter, page: $page, size: $size, sort: $sort) { content { ...MovieCard } totalElements } } fragment MovieCard on Movie { id title releaseYear rating }

name: person
description:
Returns a person by their database identifier, with the roles that connect
them to movies and TV shows. Use this when you have an exact ID, typically
from a prior `search` call. Returns null if no person exists with that ID.
To find a person by name, use `search` instead.
operation: query Tool_person($id: ID!) { person(id: $id) { id name birthYear biography photoUrl countryCode } }

name: search
description:
Case-insensitive free-text search across movies, TV shows and people. Use
this when the user names something, or part of a name, instead of describing
it with structured criteria. Returns a union, so check `__typename` on each
result before reading its fields. For structured filtering of movies alone,
use `movies`; for exact-ID lookups, use `movie`, `person` or `tvShow`.
operation: query Tool_search($query: String!) {   search(query: $query) {     __typename     ... on Movie  { ...MovieCard }     ... on TvShow { id title startYear rating }     ... on Person { id name }   } } fragment MovieCard on Movie { id title releaseYear rating }

name: tvShow
description:
Returns a TV show by its database identifier, including its seasons and
episode counts. Use this when you have an exact ID, typically from a prior
`search` call. Returns null if no TV show exists with that ID. To page
through every show, use `tvShows`; to find one by title, use `search`.
operation: query Tool_tvShow($id: ID!) { tvShow(id: $id) { id title genre rating posterUrl startYear endYear seasons plot } }

name: myWatchLists
description: The signed-in user's own watch lists, newest first.
operation: query Tool_myWatchLists { myWatchLists { id name description isPublic createdAt itemCount } }

name: addWatchListItem
description: Add a movie or TV show to one of your lists. Adding a title that is already there returns the existing entry, so retrying is safe.

titleType.description: Whether a watch-list entry points at a movie or a TV show.

operation: mutation Tool_addWatchListItem($input: AddWatchListItemInput!) {   addWatchListItem(input: $input) {     success     item { id titleType watched userNotes }     error { code message }   } }
